semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The KUROKI Laboratory is involved in research and development of semiconductor technologies, particularly SiC CMOS integrated circuits and CMOS image sensors, which are critical for advanced applications.
summary: Hiroshima University's KUROKI Laboratory is engaged in the research and development of silicon carbide (SiC) CMOS integrated circuits and CMOS image sensors. As part of the Semiconductor Industrial Technology Research Institute, it contributes to advancing semiconductor technologies for applications like autonomous driving and generative AI.
capabilities: Development of silicon carbide (SiC) CMOS integrated circuits

regional_presence.Japan: The KUROKI Laboratory is based in Japan and contributes to the semiconductor industry's growth through research and development efforts.
